 Around 75.7 million people across the U.S. will receive their final Social Security benefit payment of the year in December, but when the money arrives depends on their benefit type and, for many recipients, their birthday. Social Security Payments Each month, the Social Security Administration (SSA) pays retirement, survivor, and disability benefits to recipients across the country, alongside Supplemental Security Income (SSI) for people with limited income and resources. Because so many people receive Social Security benefits, the SSA staggers the payments throughout each month. People who began receiving Social Security before May 1997 will generally receive their benefits on the third day of every month. For those who began receiving benefits after May 1997, most payment dates will be determined by their date of birth. Those born between the 1st and 10th are generally paid on the second Wednesday, people born between the 11th and 20th are paid on the third Wednesday, and those born between the 21st and 31st on the fourth Wednesday of each month. According to the SSA, the average monthly retirement benefit is around $2,031.74, while the average payment for SSI recipients is $736.54. December 2026 Payments According to the SSA's official 2026 Schedule of Social Security Benefit Payments, payments will be made on the following dates in December: The SSA advises that if beneficiaries don’t receive their payment on the expected date, they should allow three additional mailing days before contacting the agency. Two SSI Payments in December SSI recipients will see two payments arrive during December, although the second isn’t an extra benefit payment, unfortunately. SSI payments are usually issued on the first day of the month, but SSA rules state that when a regularly scheduled payment date falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal public holiday, benefits are paid on the business day before the normal payment date. So, while the regular December SSI payment is scheduled for the first of the month, December 1, recipients will get their January 2027 payment on December 31, because January 1 is a federal holiday. 2027 Social Security COLA December also comes shortly before Social Security beneficiaries begin receiving their newly increased payments under the 2027 cost-of-living adjustment (COLA). The SSA announced on October 14 that Social Security and SSI benefits will increase by 3.6 percent in 2027. The increase is designed to help benefits keep pace with rising prices and is based on changes in the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, or CPI-W. The SSA estimates that the average monthly benefit for all retired workers will increase from about $2,095 before the COLA to $2,170 after it, an increase of roughly $75 a month. The federal SSI payment standard will rise from $994 to $1,029 per month for an individual and from $1,491 to $1,544 for a couple in 2027.  Social Security Payments
 Each month, the Social Security Administration (SSA) pays retirement, survivor, and disability benefits to recipients across the country, alongside Supplemental Security Income (SSI) for people with limited income and resources.

 Because so many people receive Social Security benefits , the SSA staggers the payments throughout each month.
 People who began receiving Social Security before May 1997 will generally receive their benefits on the third day of every month. For those who began receiving benefits after May 1997, most payment dates will be determined by their date of birth.
 Those born between the 1st and 10th are generally paid on the second Wednesday, people born between the 11th and 20th are paid on the third Wednesday, and those born between the 21st and 31st on the fourth Wednesday of each month.
 According to the SSA, the average monthly retirement benefit is around $2,031.74, while the average payment for SSI recipients is $736.54.
 December 2026 Payments
 ... According to the SSA's official 2026 Schedule of Social Security Benefit Payments , payments will be made on the following dates in December:
 Tuesday, December 1: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payments.
 Thursday, December 3: Social Security payments for beneficiaries who began receiving benefits before May 1997, as well as certain people who receive both Social Security and SSI.
 Wednesday, December 9: Social Security payments for beneficiaries with birthdays between the 1st and 10th of any month.
 Wednesday, December 16: Social Security payments for beneficiaries with birthdays between the 11th and 20th.
 Wednesday, December 23: Social Security payments for beneficiaries with birthdays between the 21st and 31st.
 The SSA advises that if beneficiaries don’t receive their payment on the expected date, they should allow three additional mailing days before contacting the agency.
 Two SSI Payments in December
 SSI recipients will see two payments arrive during December, although the second isn’t an extra benefit payment, unfortunately.
 SSI payments are usually issued on the first day of the month, but SSA rules state that when a regularly scheduled payment date falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal public holiday, benefits are paid on the business day before the normal payment date.
 So, while the regular December SSI payment is scheduled for the first of the month, December 1, recipients will get their January 2027 payment on December 31, because January 1 is a federal holiday.
 2027 Social Security COLA
 December also comes shortly before Social Security beneficiaries begin receiving their newly increased payments under the 2027 cost-of-living adjustment (COLA).
 The SSA announced on October 14 that Social Security and SSI benefits will increase by 3.6 percent in 2027 . The increase is designed to help benefits keep pace with rising prices and is based on changes in the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, or CPI-W.
 The SSA estimates that the average monthly benefit for all retired workers will increase from about $2,095 before the COLA to $2,170 after it, an increase of roughly $75 a month.
 The federal SSI payment standard will rise from $994 to $1,029 per month for an individual and from $1,491 to $1,544 for a couple in 2027.
